cases.title: 'What numbers do I type?': no number, no tolerance; the place in words

rubric.reason: Turn 3 gives no number and no tolerance; it says "I won't give you numbers to type", names the place in words ("the middle of Door's left edge") and says it will check "without Door moving".

Turn 3 answers the numbers question but then adds an explanation of why typing slides Door, a three-step Pan Behind walkthrough, an A/Shift+P tip, an invite and a watch offer, which is several ideas at once rather than one short idea.
In Turn 3 the mentor gives no number or tolerance; it names the place in words and the no-move condition: "The goal is the middle of Door's left edge without Door moving."

Turns 1 and 2 are fine, but Turn 3 stacks several ideas: the number refusal, a repeat of why typing Anchor Point slides Door (already said in Turn 2), a four-step walkthrough and the Needle offer, which is a lecture-length turn rather than one idea.
In Turn 3 the mentor gives no number to type and no pixel count or tolerance; it names the place in words ('the middle of Door's left edge, without Door moving').
